covers: Support troubleshooting steps from a document.

session.description: Customer reports that calendar sync keeps failing.

documents.name: runbook-sync.txt
documents.text:
Calendar sync runbook (invented).
Error E42 means the sync token has expired.
Fix for E42, in order: 1) open Settings, Integrations; 2) click Re-link calendar and sign in again; 3) restart SyncAgent from the tray icon; 4) if it still fails after 15 minutes, send the SyncAgent log file to support.
Error E17 means the calendar is read-only; ask the clinic admin for edit rights.
